description: Source code implementing X509 auxiliary data handling functions for OpenSSL, including routines for setting and getting certificate auxiliary data such as alias and key ID, and managing trust and reject objects.

methods.name: aux_get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates auxiliary data for an X509 certificate.

methods.name: X509_alias_set1
methods.description: Sets the alias string in the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_keyid_set1
methods.description: Sets the key ID in the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_alias_get0
methods.description: Retrieves the alias string from the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_keyid_get0
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID from the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_add1_trust_object
methods.description: Adds a trust object to the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_add1_reject_object
methods.description: Adds a reject object to the certificate auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_trust_clear
methods.description: Clears trust objects from the auxiliary data.

methods.name: X509_reject_clear
methods.description: Clears reject objects from the auxiliary data.
